jobDescription:
Job Description – Service Now ITSM
- Architect / Tech Lead Role Overview We are seeking an experienced Service Now ITSM Specialist with strong functional and technical expertise across ITSM, HRSD, and SPM modules. The ideal candidate will have a proven track record of designing and implementing Service Now solutions, developing custom workflows, driving platform optimization, and integrating Service Now with third‑party systems such as Microsoft Intune, SAP and Jira. Additionally, the candidate should have strong communication skills to elicit requirements from business users and translate that into technical requirements. Should have played the role of Architect / Tech Lead to guide the team of the ITSM and other modules. Handled the team of service now developers and set standards for key areas to deliver quality Service experience. Key Responsibilities
1. Requirements Engineering & Business Analysis Conduct discovery workshops with stakeholders to elicit, analyze, and document business requirements. Translate high-level business needs into detailed User Stories and Acceptance Criteria. Perform gap analysis between current business processes and Service Now out-of-the-box (OOTB) functionality. Create process workflows and documentation (Process Maps, Wireframes, Functional Design Docs).
2. Solution Design & Configuration Design and configure solutions across ITSM, SPM, and HRSD modules, prioritizing OOTB configuration over custom development. Configure forms, fields, UI Policies, and Client Scripts to support business requirements. Manage Demand Management intake, including dashboard creation and reporting for executive stakeholders. Support the implementation of integrations (Intune, SAP, Jira) by defining integration requirements and mapping data fields.

Lead User Acceptance Testing (UAT), including the creation of test plans, test cases, and coordination of sign-offs. Manage system documentation and training materials for end-users to ensure high adoption rates.
4. Platform Governance & Optimization Promote adherence to CSDM (Common Service Data Model) and ITIL best practices. Analyze platform usage metrics to identify opportunities for automation and performance improvement. Support the team during platform upgrades by assessing the impact of new features on existing configurations. title: SAP HANA MM Functional Consultant (SE)
company: Renault Nissan Technology and Business Centre
jobDescription:
Job Summary:** We are seeking an experienced SAP MM Functional (SE) to join our team at RNTBCI PL. This role involves implementing, and supporting SAP SD solutions, with a focus on cloud computing environments and complex ERP integrations. Job

RESPONSIBILITIES:
** * Capable to design, configuration, and implementation of SAP MM modules, ensuring alignment with business requirements. * Participate in full lifecycle SAP project implementations, including blueprinting, realization, testing, and go-live support. * Collaborate with business users to gather requirements, analyze processes, and translate them into effective SAP solutions. * Integrate SAP MM with other SAP modules (e.g., MM, PP) and external systems, leveraging strong ERP integration expertise. * Contribute to the overall SAP architecture design and ensure best practices are followed. * Provide ongoing software support and troubleshoot issues related to SAP SD functionality. * Utilize knowledge of SAP S/4HANA and SAP Success Factors in relevant projects. * Engage in software development activities, including custom enhancements and reports using SAPUI5. * Manage system administration tasks related to SAP environments. * Apply version control best practices for configuration and development objects. * Stay updated with the latest advancements in SAP technology, particularly in cloud computing. Job

QUALIFICATIONS:
** * Extensive experience as an SAP MM Functional consultant. * Strong understanding of Cloud Computing principles and their application within SAP environments. * Proven expertise in ERP Integrations. * Solid knowledge of SAP Architecture. * In-depth SAP Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) expertise. * Comprehensive SAP Knowledge across various modules. * Familiarity with SAP MM,SD, FI Module and SAP PP (Production Planning). * Demonstrated experience in SAP Project Implementation. * Proficiency with SAP S/4HANA. * Familiarity with SAPUI5 for custom development. * Experience in Software Development and Software Support. * Understanding of System Administration principles. * Proficiency in Version Control systems.
